## Profile

Statistician and data analyst working across research, monitoring and evaluation, and business intelligence. I combine quantitative analysis, qualitative research and dashboarding to produce evidence that decision-makers can use.

## Education

**BSc in Statistics**

## Current role

**Data Analyst**, ADAC Consultancy

## Core competencies

- Research design, sampling and data collection tools
- Statistical analysis and interpretation of survey and programme data
- Qualitative coding and thematic analysis
- Monitoring and evaluation: indicators, data quality and reporting
- Data visualisation and dashboards
- Data science and data analysis workflows

## Software and tools

| Area | Tools |
|---|---|
| Statistical analysis | SPSS, Stata, R (RStudio), Python |
| Qualitative research | NVivo, ATLAS.ti |
| Databases and spreadsheets | SQL, Excel |
| Visualisation and BI | Tableau, Power BI |
